after: Handle a large volume of literature while keeping judgment with human reviewers, and report how accurate the AI extraction was.

Two human assessors screened titles and abstracts without AI; data extraction ran three parallel ChatGPT rounds per article in separate conversations with GPT-4 and GPT-4o, and ChatGPT merged each model's runs; a third reviewer, who also ran the AI extraction, compared the human and AI answers and took the majority answer, deciding ties independently; ROBINS-I was applied for quality; accuracy was compared with chi-square tests.
